deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

location.description: The region of the data lineage configuration for integration.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

parent.description:
Parent scope for the config.
Format: projects/{project-id|project-number} or folders/{folder-number} or organizations/{organization-number}.

ingestion.description: Defines how Lineage should be ingested for this resource.

ingestion.rule.description: List of ingestion rules for Data Lineage ingestion.

ingestion.rule.integration_selector.description: Selects which integration this rule applies to.

ingestion.rule.integration_selector.inte.description: Integration to which the rule applies. Possible values: ["DATAPROC", "LOOKER_CORE"]

ingestion.rule.lineage_enablement.description: Configures lineage ingestion enablement for this scope.

ingestion.rule.lineage_enablement.enable.description: Whether ingestion of lineage should be enabled.
